summary: Small single-engine fixed-wing plane crashed west of Horsetooth Reservoir in the Sawmill Trail area around 7 p.m. Sunday. The two adult occupants were out of the plane with only minor injuries and were transported to a local hospital. Larimer County Sheriff's Office deputies, Larimer County Department of Natural Resources rangers, and Poudre Fire Authority responded; LCSO investigators assisted the NTSB and FAA and sought public photos/video of the flight.
location: Sawmill Trail, west of Horsetooth Reservoir
responding_agency: Larimer County Sheriff's Office; Larimer County Department of Natural Resources; Poudre Fire Authority
